Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Enabled_t:
Turn off to stop new addon reactions and restore the previous AI tuning. Already-started actions can finish. Changes apply within 2 seconds after world settings are synchronized.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Debug_too:
Print extra diagnostics to the game log.
Default: off.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.React_Ena:
Allow an earlier attack on nearby zombies while existing orders and combat decisions remain respected.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.React_Nea:
React to a zombie this close without requiring it to approach.
Default: 2.5.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.React_Clo:
Maximum distance for reacting early to an approaching zombie.
Default: 6.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.React_Nee:
An approaching zombie beyond the immediate reaction distance must be visible.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.React_Una: Leave unarmed NPC reactions to A-Life

Do not make unarmed NPCs initiate an earlier attack.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Ena:
Gate early attacks against crowds and allow bounded crowd retreat.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Saf:
Check local routes, hazards and known zombies before choosing a destination. Off restores the legacy geometric retreat, which can pick unsafe or unreachable destinations.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Rad:
Count nearby zombies on the same floor within this radius.
Default: 6.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Gat:
At this crowd size, leave close-contact combat decisions to A-Life.
Default: 3.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Fal:
Minimum crowd size before an addon retreat is considered.
Default: 3.

At least this many nearby zombies must be approaching the NPC.
Default: 2.

Maximum local retreat distance; the safe planner may choose a shorter route.
Default: 8.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Reg:
Consider a nearby ally as a regrouping preference, never as a reason to ignore route safety.
Default: 20.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Coo:
Minimum pause after an addon retreat attempt.
Default: 6000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Leg:
Limit repeated crowd-retreat moves for each NPC.
Default: 3.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Crowd_Tim:
Maximum duration of one addon crowd-retreat move.
Default: 4500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_E:
Enable existing vehicle courtesy steps, dodges and dives.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_S:
Lower values update vehicle motion more often and cost more CPU time.
Default: 100.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_R:
Consider vehicles within this distance.
Default: 14.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_L:
React when a vehicle trajectory passes this close to the NPC.
Default: 2.0.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_H:
Look this far ahead along the vehicle trajectory.
Default: 2.2.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_D:
Use a dive when a sufficiently fast vehicle is due this soon.
Default: 1.0.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_M:
Ignore slower vehicles in the threat scan.
Default: 6.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_D:
Minimum vehicle speed for a dive reaction.
Default: 25.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_S:
Use a dodge above this speed; slower vehicles can prompt an idle NPC to step aside.
Default: 12.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_C:
An idle NPC may step aside for a slow vehicle this close.
Default: 5.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_D:
Distance of a vehicle dodge.
Default: 3.

Distance of an urgent vehicle dive.
Default: 4.5.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_C:
Distance of a slow step aside.
Default: 2.

Minimum pause between vehicle reactions for one NPC.
Default: 1500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Vehicle_T:
Maximum duration of one vehicle-avoidance move.
Default: 2500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Lines_Ena:
Enable the addon reaction lines.
Default: on.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Lines_Coo:
Default pause per NPC and situation; urgent situations keep their own limits.
Default: 8000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Lines_Spo:
Pause between zombie-spotting lines from one NPC.
Default: 20000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Lease_Zom:
Cap how long an NPC avoids the same zombie after retreating.
Default: 8000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Ignore_Zo:
Cap the ignore time after a failed approach or blocked route to a zombie.
Default: 4000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Draw_Scal:
Scale weapon drawing animation time. 1 keeps the base timing.
Default: 0.8.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Combat_Me:
Pause before preparing a melee attack.
Default: 120.

Recovery pause after a melee attack.
Default: 520.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Combat_At:
Minimum interval used by the NPC attack decision.
Default: 500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Combat_Un:
Combat pause after a target is unreachable.
Default: 700.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Combat_Le:
Self-defence distance while an NPC is constrained by a post or leash.
Default: 2.0.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Combat_Cl:
Chance to run while closing on a target.
Default: 100.

Only run toward a target at least this far away.
Default: 3.5.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.MeleeDela:
Pause after a one-handed swing animation.
Default: 250.

Pause after a two-handed swing animation.
Default: 300.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Endurance:
Endurance level required before returning to combat.
Default: 50.

Minimum duration of an endurance retreat.
Default: 1500.

Retreat duration after recent damage.
Default: 1500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Survival_:
Health ratio below which recent damage can trigger retreat. Never goes below the base retreat-health threshold.
Default: 0.45.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Lanes_Pas:
Passive decision interval for nearby NPCs. Lower values cost more CPU time.
Default: 150.

Passive decision interval at medium distance.
Default: 400.

Passive decision interval for distant NPCs.
Default: 1200.

Radius around a player that uses the nearby NPC scan interval.
Default: 16.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Focus_Ign:
Ignore interval used by the A-Life and Jeem zombie-focus filters.
Default: 400.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Focus_Clo:
Approaching-zombie radius in the A-Life and Jeem focus filters.
Default: 18.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Focus_Min:
Raise a smaller A-Life focus radius to this minimum; does not lower larger values.
Default: 10.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Fear_Igno:
Zombie ignore interval used by the fear module.
Default: 500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Fear_FarT:
Far-distance threshold in the fear module.
Default: 10.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Caution_W:
Pause while waiting for zombies to pass.
Default: 1500.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Caution_L:
Pause used by the light-danger caution behavior.
Default: 1200.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Gun_RollM:
How often gun discipline can reconsider whether to shoot a zombie.
Default: 10000.
Sandbox_ALifeReactiveSurvivors.Report_Ev:
Write changed counters to the log at this interval. 0 disables reports.
Default: 1.
